name: Slack
showcaseSub: Sandbox: sample channels only; nothing is posted to a real Slack workspace.
gate: Works with your Slack workspace once the platform's Slack app is set up
pickChannelHelp: The CRM posts alerts here. Private channels appear only if the Slack app was invited to them.
includeNamesHelp: Off by default: alerts then show the source and a link, not a person's name.
reconnect: Slack access was revoked. Reconnect Slack to resume alerts.
testContext: If you can read this, alerts are reaching this channel.

errors.not_found: That Slack connection was not found.
errors.token_rejected: Slack rejected the access token. Reconnect Slack.
errors.channel_not_available: That channel is not available to the Slack app.
errors.cannot_join: The Slack app could not join that channel. Invite it from Slack and try again.
errors.vault_failed: Could not store the Slack settings. Try again.
errors.audit_failed: Could not record the change in the audit log, so it was not applied.
